newsitem.title: FRANCE: Usinor up strongly on FT article.
newsitem.headline: Usinor up strongly on FT article.

text.p: Shares in Usinor-Sacilor, Europe's biggest steel maker, posted gains on Monday on the back of a Financial Times article saying steel prices were stabilising in Europe after a long decline.
At 1423 GMT, Usinor was up 2.79 percent at 77.40 francs while the CAC.40 index was down 0.64 percent.

Usinor's share price had been relatively stable around 80 francs since its first half results, on September 24. But the share slipped recently on expectations of steel price cuts for 1997 and a sharp forecast cut by brokers Transbourse.
